ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the scanner command, scan scope and the ignore-exit flag are declared; it does not run the scanner.
offer: Run the available leak scanner against the staged change and keep its failure authoritative. A missing scanner needs installation guidance rather than a clean secret-safety claim.

minimal.reason: Declare the scanner command run on staged changes. A missing scanner needs installation guidance, not a clean claim, so name the tool.

mid.reason: Declare what the scan covers, such as staged files. An undefined scope may skip content, so state it.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring the scanner exit status to false. A scanner failure must block, otherwise a leak passes, so keep its exit authoritative.
